kpnee01.title: Neptune to Aries: The Two-Day Soulmate
kpnee01.caption:
Met them Tuesday, picking venues by Thursday. Neptune loves a whirlwind, but even the best films have a middle.
Which sign skips straight to the ending in your group chat?

kpnee02.title: Neptune to Taurus: The Memory Filter
kpnee02.caption:
Missing an ex can make the old photos glow pinker than they were. The good parts were real, and so were the reasons it ended.
Keep the warmth, not the plan to go back.

kpnee03.title: Neptune to Gemini: The Stranger on Platform 2
kpnee03.caption:
Gemini built a whole cottage life for a stranger in two train stops, dog included. Then said one word out loud.
Who else has a full daydream going on their commute?

kpnee04.title: Neptune to Cancer: Their Lines, Not Yours
kpnee04.caption:
If you've already written their rejection for them, that's your fear talking, not their answer. Ask kindly, then let them speak for themselves.
Save this for the next time you're scripting both sides.

kpnee05.title: Neptune to Leo: Not the Premiere
kpnee05.caption:
Leo expected a string quartet and a hot-air balloon. Got a picnic blanket and a really good sandwich. Honestly? Better.
What's the best small date you've been on?

kpnee06.title: Neptune to Virgo: One Line Blank
kpnee06.caption: Nobody matches a forty-point list, and that's not a flaw in them. Keep what truly matters (kind, honest, shows up) and leave a little room to be surprised.

kpnee07.title: Neptune to Libra: Just the Trailer
kpnee07.caption:
Libra fell for the coat, the playlist and all six photos. Gorgeous trailer. The film is called a first date.
Tag the friend who's in love with a profile right now.

kpnee08.title: Neptune to Scorpio: The Tinted Lenses
kpnee08.caption: Calling late replies and cancelled plans mysterious is easy when you really like someone. Look at how they treat you, not the mystery. You deserve someone clear.

kpnee09.title: Neptune to Sagittarius: Coffee, Not a Flight
kpnee09.caption:
One hour at a festival and Sag is already at the departures board. Neptune approves of the meet-cute. The next scene is just a coffee.
Who in your life would book the flight?

kpnee10.title: Neptune to Capricorn: Permission to Daydream
kpnee10.caption:
You can plan your whole life and still forget to feel it. Letting yourself want something isn't off-schedule.
This is your permission to daydream a little.

kpnee11.title: Neptune to Aquarius: Caught Watching the Rom-Com
kpnee11.caption:
"I don't do romance. It was research." Paused on the airport scene, though.
Which sign secretly rewatches the same love story every winter?

kpnee12.title: Neptune to Pisces: The Movie in Your Head
kpnee12.caption:
Three sweet texts and a whole future in your head. Pisces, the daydream is lovely, but the real one replies, makes plans and shows up on a rainy Tuesday.
Stay for the ending.
